notes.title: Oculus Touch Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26226343/b4e2a3c4ea686e53ceda1ee439e4170c026f4a98.png[/img][h1]Announcing Official Oculus Touch Support![/h1]

While working on a larger future update, we decided to make an intermediate update with Oculus Touch support!

Stay tuned for more!

[u][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/u]
[list]
 [*] Added Oculus Touch support.
 [*] Fixed bug with aiming system so that it no longer disappears when aiming at the sky.
 [*] Improved visual effects.
[/list]
